title: Frequency-dependent stride–swing coupling: an underpowered cross-database Parkinson prediction test
abstract: A fixed stride-duration/swing-fraction spectral-coherence contrast did not establish added Parkinson case-status prediction across gaitpdb→gaitndd: among 36 source and 24 target eligible participants, target delta log loss was 0.006553 nats (joint bootstrap 95% interval [-0.221617, 0.111513]). Severe eligibility selection and prior dataset reuse limit this to an exploratory cross-database test, not evidence of equivalence or proven participant-independent confirmation.
